item.title: Jacob & Co. named fastest growing Swiss watch brand of 2025
item.description: Retail Jeweller Jacob & Co. named fastest growing Swiss watch brand of 2025 Jacob & Co. has been identified as the fastest growing Swiss watch brand of 2025, according to the Ninth Annual Swiss Watch Industry Report published by Morgan Stanley in partnership with LuxeConsult. Jacob & Co. named fastest growing Swiss watch brand of 2025 Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Pippa Small unveils AW26 collection
item.description: Retail Jeweller Pippa Small unveils AW26 collection The collection opens with Orpheus, featuring Madagascan labradorite carved into clean, elemental squares and rectangles. Low-polished to reveal flashes of kingfisher blue and peacock turquoise, the stones are set in 18ct gold across rings, pendants and tile bracelets. The pieces have a monolithic presence, establishing… Pippa Small unveils AW26 collection Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller Laboratory-grown diamonds now dominate engagement ring sales at Queensmith London-based jeweller Queensmith reports that its customers are opting for larger laboratory-grown diamonds, with average engagement ring spend holding steady at £5,750. item.title: Camden Market trader pleads guilty after £106,000 of unhallmarked silver seized
item.description: Retail Jeweller Camden Market trader pleads guilty after £106,000 of unhallmarked silver seized A Camden Market jewellery trader has pleaded guilty to four offences under the Hallmarking Act 1973 following the seizure of more than £106,000 worth of unhallmarked silver.
